content: We need to provide SMILES of the unknown sample. We have no data. We need to get data from the lab: maybe we can retrieve NMR, IR, mass spec, etc. The task says "perform a careful analysis and provide the SMILES code, using only the necessary time and materials." So we need to determine structure from spectral data. We need to request spectra. Let's start by retrieving mass spec, proton NMR, carbon NMR, IR. Use tools.
